confirmationMethod: Separate in-app browser accessibility/visible-DOM inspection without WatchLayer rendering, consent, forms or account interactions; paired with bounded raw HTTP capture before production changes.
scopeLimitation: These are public browser-observability targets. Grainne Dolan is in Ireland, Paraclearth is in Nigeria, and Zahoot is a UK directory/platform. They do not establish England-and-Wales firm applicability or SRA rule accuracy. Any experimental LawWatch output requires separate applicability review and is not a customer assessment.
